lines: Well. A cub from the loud hill, fallen out of the sky.
bear.d1.l1.speaker: burl

choices.text: Have you seen the blinking light?

lines: And cubs don't fly. Yet here we both are.
bear.d1.l3.speaker: burl

lines: Check my ears for brass, then. Gently.
bear.d1.a.l1.speaker: burl

lines: One. The blue ones are mine. They are all blue.
bear.d1.b.l1.speaker: burl

lines: Since my grandmother was a cub. It never tires.
bear.d1.c.l1.speaker: burl

lines: Go on, sky-cub. Walk soft. The wild is listening.
bear.d1.close.speaker: burl

lines: Back again? The berries are still mine. Mostly.
bear.repeat.speaker: burl

lines: Five boars have found my berry slope.
They root up the bushes, and they do not share.
I am too old to chase. You have steel, sky-cub.
bear.q.offer.speaker: burl

lines: Good. Mind the tusks. They charge straight, turn slow.
bear.q.accepted.speaker: burl

lines: Then sit a while. The boars will still be rude.
bear.q.later.speaker: burl

lines: Still snorting down there. I can hear them chewing.
bear.q.active.speaker: burl

lines: Quiet. Listen. Only bees now, and the wind.
bear.q.ready.speaker: burl

lines: Thank you, sky-cub. The slope can breathe again.
bear.q.thanks.speaker: burl

lines: Quiet slope, full bushes. Still not the blue ones.
bear.q.done.speaker: burl
